_comment: Copy to pricing.json (git-ignored). Prices per million tokens; keys must match the --model spec exactly. Cost columns stay empty, and --budget refuses to run, for paid models not listed here. GLM-4.6: Z.ai list price (docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing, checked 2026-10-23); the attestor calls open.bigmodel.cn, which bills in CNY and may differ, so confirm on your account's billing page. GLM-4-Plus is not on Z.ai's list: fill it in from bigmodel.cn before using --budget with it. OpenAI/Anthropic: fill in from each provider's pricing page. Long-prompt tiers: add "long_context": {"above_prompt_tokens": N, "multiplier": M} (every token of a call billed M x once the prompt passes N). Haiku 5.5 and gpt-6-luna: $0.10/$0.50 list price per aggregator listings checked 2026-11-15; confirm on the providers' pricing pages.
